config:
# Hermes Agent config for one headless trial. Written from pin.json. Copied to
# $HERMES_HOME/config.yaml (under /harness-state) by adapter.sh before the
# turn. Secrets are not here: the adapter exports ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (the
# per-trial proxy token) and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (the proxy) in the process
# environment, which the anthropic provider reads.
_config_version: 46

model:
  provider: "anthropic"
  default: "claude-sonnet-5-5"

terminal:
  backend: "local"
  cwd: "/workspace"
  timeout: 180
  home_mode: "profile"

display:
  streaming: false

# Nothing that needs a person: no update checks, no telemetry prompts.
auto_update: false
check_for_updates: false

mcp_servers:
  world:
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:9/mcp"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer world-token-golden"
    timeout: 120
    connect_timeout: 60
